specs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one production film-preset cover for an iPhone camera app, square 1024 x 1024.
Adapt the supplied packaging artwork into ONE flat, full-bleed square film-box front, matching the supplied existing app cover sheet. The existing app cover sheet is a style reference ONLY; output no contact sheet or mockup. Its bold condensed lettering, restrained screen-printed color blocks, barely visible matte paper texture, and thumbnail legibility are the invariants. View the result straight on, orthographic, with perfectly square edges. Artwork reaches all four canvas edges; no surrounding margin, rounded corners, border, cast shadow, perspective, photographed box, cartridge, background object or scene.
Use researched packaging colors and graphic motifs specified below, with a clear visual hierarchy and clean correct typography. Do not add JustShoot, RAW, sRGB, arrows, app UI, watermarks, unrelated stocks, cameras, landscapes, extra slogans or decoration. At 108px square the preset name must remain easy to read.
Input image 2 is the actual historical FUJICHROME ASTIA 100F five-pack, a PRODUCT reference, not a box shape to copy. Keep its FUJIFILM green, muted champagne-gold ASTIA strip, black Professional strip and violet-blue stock identification color (documented in Fujifilm's ASTIA 100F bulletin). Reformat those real printed panels into the square front style of the existing app images.
Composition: Fujifilm green upper field about 40%; a broad muted gold name band across the middle with large black condensed "ASTIA"; thin black band beneath with small cream italic "Professional"; violet-blue lower field about 35%. Include a modest white "FUJIFILM" wordmark near the upper edge and white "FUJICHROME" just above the name band. Large white "100F" in lower field and very small "DAYLIGHT" beneath. Bottom-right small print only: "35mm–36EXP" and "ISO 100 · E-6". Match the authentic 100F generation, not the older ASTIA 100 packaging. Keep ASTIA the dominant word. This is an adapted packaging cover; do not invent a different ASTIA palette.

Transform ONLY its left-hand yellow-orange square box front into the app's finished cover style; omit the cartridge and white surrounding area. This is a simulation identity, not a historical Kodak stock. Preserve the specific official motif: warm golden ochre full-bleed background, a bold vertical vermilion-red stripe through the center, and a black-outlined horizontal bow-tie label spanning the middle with solid black inward-pointing triangles at its ends. Follow that official image's word hierarchy: large cream letters with black fine outlines "FUJI" inside the top half of the label; "CLASSIC CHROME" in crisp tall black condensed type in the lower half, large enough to read on a 108px thumbnail. Make label occupy the central 55% of the canvas height. Only additional print is small "FILM SIMULATION" in the lower-right, matching the small technical imprint positioning of existing app covers. No ISO, exposure count, E-6, C-41, 35mm, Kodak, Kodachrome, SUPERIA or fake physical film specification. Keep this an authentic adaptation of the official golden/orange-and-red graphic, not arbitrary green Fuji packaging.
